Boston, Worcester, and Sunderland (all MA) are planning on having
storyline events, they just need to confirm their dates. Bangor, ME
has scheduled theirs for July 21st. (Powerbase Bangor Website:
http://geocities.com/bspaul41/Powerbase_Bangor.html)

Storyline Providence, RI has been set up for September 13th

Lambach's Legion: Providence
Date: Saturday, September 13, 2003
Start Time: noon
Place: Tactics Games, 505 Waterman Ave., East Providence, RI
(401) 435-6666
Format: Storyline Constructed
Number of rounds: 3 plus 1 final
Time limit for each round: 2 hours
Contact: Matt Hirsch, mon...@hotpop.com
http://www.darkwindrising.com/vampire/events.asp

So thats 5 New England Lambach's Legion events that I know of. I
suspect that CT will be also holding their own storyline event as
well.

-Matt
